captions.start: Face the step, hold the rail

steps.text: Stand facing a low step and hold a rail.
Step up with one foot and bring the other foot up.
Straighten the leading leg fully at the top.
Step down slowly. Change the leading leg each time.

safety: Use a step no higher than 15 cm.
Hold the rail the whole time.

mistakes.label: knee_not_straight
mistakes.wrong: your leading leg was not fully straight at the top of the step
mistakes.right: Straighten your leading leg at the top, holding the rail, as far as is comfortable.

mistakes.label: drop_down
mistakes.wrong: you came down from the step too quickly
mistakes.right: Step down slowly, holding the rail, and let your foot touch down gently.

setup: Put the step side-on to the phone, with the step in the picture.
